product.name: Unsecured Business Loans
product.description: Digital unsecured working capital loans for semiformal small businesses in Africa, processed via a mobile app with approval typically within 24 hours.

product.name: Financial Record-Keeping Tool
product.description: A mobile app feature that allows small business owners to record daily sales and expenses to manage their business finances.
